posteriores.texto: “Portanto, meu senhor, o rei, não ponha no coração a notícia de que todos os filhos do rei morreram, pois somente Amnom morreu.”
Absalão fugiu. O jovem que estava de vigia levantou os olhos e viu uma grande multidão vindo pelo caminho atrás dele, pela encosta do monte.

kjv.texto: And Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David’s brother, answered and said, Let not my lord suppose that they have slain all the young men the king’s sons; for Amnon only is dead: for by the appointment of Absalom this hath been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.

vizinhos.31: Then the king arose, and tare his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes rent.
vizinhos.33: Now therefore let not my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king’s sons are dead: for Amnon only is dead.
